title: San Juan watershed storm, October 2026
description: PRISM precipitation for the October 2026 storm over the San Juan watershed (HUC 1408), averaged into H3 hexagons and extruded by depth.
day_note: Each PRISM day is the 24 hours ending 12:00 UTC on its date, 6 a.m. to 6 a.m. MDT.
source: PRISM 800 m daily precipitation, aggregated to H3 by cell center
